failureMessage: KRALİ geliştirme regresyon hafızasını iyileştir (developer.suggestion.research.277e9623-550) native local agent iteration sınırına ulaştı.

diagnosis.summary: Iteration limit is most likely from a scope/evidence mismatch: the approved gap (bind failed candidates to test outcome, failure class, and user feedback) is only partially implemented in DENY-listed AgentDevelopmentSuggestionStore.regressionMemory, while ALLOW-scoped research cannot land relevant external evidence because AgentResearchQueryPlanner.developmentPlan/generalPlan lack bilingual regression-memory concept aliases—so AgentWebResearch throws WebResearchError.noResults.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Development web research for this gap fails relevance because Turkish lexical facets (e.g. regresyon/hafiza) are searched and scored without English regression-memory aliases, so conceptCoverage never qualifies and search ends as WebResearchError.noResults ("Web araştırması yeterince alakalı sonuç üretmedi.").
evidence: AgentResearchQueryPlanner has no regression/regresyon/hafiza/failure-class/feedback aliases; generalPlan bilingual groups cover macos/video/mail/etc. but not this family.
developmentPlan falls back to lexicalConcepts on the mission and appends English academic wrappers to Turkish subjects; relevanceEvaluation requires concept hits in title/snippet/domain.
isExternalResearchTopic topicSignals are English-only (memory/agent/replay/…); Turkish "hafıza" does not match "memory".

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: The true atomic product gap is DENY-blocked: AgentDevelopmentSuggestionStore.regressionMemory only token-overlaps suggestion title/reason among .failed states and never correlates test results, failure class, or user feedback—so a trustworthy candidate that fully satisfies the evidence sentence cannot be produced inside ALLOW, causing thrash to local_agent_iteration_limit.
evidence: Innovation gap text equals seeded innovation:regression-memory reason about test sonucu / hata sınıfı / kullanıcı geri bildirimi.
regressionMemory filters state == .failed and matches meaningfulTokens(title+reason) only; no test/failureClass/feedback fields are used.
ALLOW excludes AgentDevelopmentSuggestionStore.swift; DENY and authority rules forbid widening into store/runner/engine.
AgentLocalIntelligence has no regressionMemory / failureClass / test-result binding helpers for this gap.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Even inside research architecture, AgentDevelopmentResearchImpactMap.regressionChecks is only a Set dump of verificationContract + behavioralBenchmark + rollbackCondition, so the research contract does not force the missing semantic dimensions (failure class × test outcome × feedback) as an atomic evidence-bound regression primitive.
evidence: ImpactMap.build concatenates those three arrays; verifier only checks non-emptiness of verification/benchmark/rollback, not failure-class/test/feedback binding.
No regression-memory-specific facet/classifier gate beyond generic "memory" agent-context in AgentDevelopmentResearchSourceClassifier.requiresAgentContext.

recommendedNextSteps: Implement the smallest ALLOW-scoped primitive in AgentResearchQueryPlanner: when mission tokens signal regresyon/regression + hafiza/memory and/or failure/hata + test/feedback/geri-bildirim families, emit generic English development facets and query variants (agent regression memory, failure class clustering, test-outcome feedback, case-based repair / experience replay) plus matching conceptGroups aliases—no app/brand hard-codes.
Optionally mirror the same alias family in AgentWebResearch relevance concept grouping so English primary sources can satisfy coverage for TR missions.

If still within primitivePatch, extend AgentDevelopmentResearchImpactMap.build and/or AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier to require explicit generic regression-dimension coverage (failureClass, testOutcome, userFeedback) derived from proposal verification/benchmark text—not a SuggestionStore rewrite.
Do not attempt to mutate AgentDevelopmentSuggestionStore.regressionMemory under the current ALLOW/DENY contract; escalate a separate scoped approval if store-level correlation is required.
testsRequired: Extend Scripts/development-research-quality-self-test.swift: developmentPlan on a generic TR regression-memory mission must produce English alias facets/queries; a relevant agent-memory/failure-replay paper must qualify; an irrelevant Apple doc must remain Tier D.
If ImpactMap/verifier dimensions are added, assert non-empty structured regressionChecks covering failure-class/test/feedback semantics without hard-coding the innovation title.
warnings: Current ALLOW cannot lawfully implement the store-level correlation described in the gap evidence; research-only patches improve evidence gathering/contracts, not live historical candidate risk binding.
Do not hard-code the specific suggestion title, innovation:regression-memory fingerprint, or one user sentence.
WebResearchError.noResults is a relevance/coverage failure after providers returned candidates, distinct from allProvidersFailed.
